common_decisions.C4_disclosure: Where exploratory values of the primary contrast were seen before the freeze, the freeze record says so, with the values and where they are stored.

c4_disclosure.statement: Exploratory values of the primary contrast (greedy minus uniform) and of the EXP-002 contrasts were seen before the freeze, at the DRAFT setting (h0 = 1 day, sigma = 0.75, pre-amendment greedy and Leitner rules), on exploratory seeds 1 to 30 (disjoint from all confirmatory seeds). No run at the frozen setting has computed any contrast: the only run at the fitted setting (PROBE-005) ran the uniform arm alone. The amendments were set by the owner's approvals and the calibration rule, not chosen from these values.
other_disclosures: Calibration CAL-001: held-out log-loss of the calibrated exponential curve 0.587 vs 0.328 for a constant predictor (model-form misfit).
Regime: baseline-only PROBE-005 at the fitted setting, mean uniform R 0.959 (exponential) and 0.810 (power law), seeds 1-30: near ceiling for EXP-001.
Session interpretation: 'cover every item' implemented as a coverage-first key (every item reviewed at least once), not a per-item quota (D-010).
